description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

description.zh: 账户ID(request_param.accountId)不超过50个字符，支持“*”、“？”通配符。
description.en: The account ID (request_param.accountId). The value can be up to 50 characters in length and supports the "\*" and "?" wildcards.

description.zh: 日志开始的时间戳。单位：毫秒。
description.en: The start timestamp of the log. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 全文匹配1，不能超过30个字符。
description.en: The first full-text match condition. The value can be up to 30 characters in length.

description.zh: 全文匹配2，不能超过30个字符。
description.en: The second full-text match condition. The value can be up to 30 characters in length.

description.zh: 全文匹配3，不能超过30个字符。
description.en: The third full-text match condition. The value can be up to 30 characters in length.
The current page number.
The device type (request_param.deviceType). Example values: 1: PC. 2: MOBILE.
The email address (request_param.email). The value can be up to 100 characters in length and supports the "\*" and "?" wildcards.
The end time. Unit: milliseconds.
The logon failure reason (-request_param.failReason).
The IP address (request_param.ip). The value can be up to 20 characters in length and supports the "\*" and "?" wildcards.
The logon success flag (request_param.loginResult).
The logon authentication method (-request_param.loginType).

description.zh: 设备MAC地址(-request_param.mac)，不超过30个字符，支持“*”、“？”通配符。
description.en: The device MAC address (-request_param.mac). The value can be up to 30 characters in length and supports the "\*" and "?" wildcards.

description.zh: 手机号(支持MD5request_param.mobile/request_param.mobileMd5)，不超过30个字符，支持“*”、“？”通配符，按照字段mobile、mobileMd5两个字符进行搜索。
description.en: The phone number (supports MD5: request_param.mobile/request_param.mobileMd5). The value can be up to 30 characters in length and supports the "\*" and "?" wildcards. The search is performed based on the mobile and mobileMd5 fields.

description.zh: 账户昵称(request_param.nickName)不超过50个字符，支持“*”、“？”通配符。
description.en: The account nickname (request_param.nickName). The value can be up to 50 characters in length and supports the "\*" and "?" wildcards.
The operation source (request_param.operateSource). Example values: 1: PC. 2: H5. 3: App.
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.
The referer (-request_param.refer). The value can be up to 50 characters in length and supports the "\*" and "?" wildcards.
The region code.

description.zh: 账户注册IP(request_param.registerIp)，不超过20个字符，支持“*”、“？”通配符。
description.en: The account registration IP address (request_param.registerIp). The value can be up to 20 characters in length and supports the "\*" and "?" wildcards.
The request ID.

description.zh: 分值区间终止值(score)，只能输入非负整数，右区间必须大于左区间，左右区间都取闭合。
description.en: The end value of the score range (score). Only non-negative integers are allowed. The end value must be greater than the start value. Both boundaries are inclusive.

description.zh: 分值区间起始值(score)，只能输入非负整数，右区间必须大于左区间，左右区间都取闭合。
description.en: The start value of the score range (score). Only non-negative integers are allowed. The end value must be greater than the start value. Both boundaries are inclusive.
The event name (instance_id).
The risk label (tags). The data is obtained from DescribeTagsList.
The device ID (device_info.umid).
The user agent (-request_param.userAgent). The value can be up to 50 characters in length and supports the "\*" and "?" wildcards.
The account name type for the logon scenario (-request_param.userNameType).
